engine.fee_rule: taker: fees = roundup(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)) where M is the per-series fee_multiplier published by the demo API on GET /series/{ticker} (official Get Series schema: https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-series), cached in series_fees and defaulting to 1 when a series record has not been fetched (fee schedule PDF https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf, effective 2026-07-07: 'default is 1 unless otherwise indicated'). The production PDF's Non-Standard table lists taker M=0 for KXBTCY/KXETHY while the demo API publishes fee_multiplier=1 for them - that official-source conflict is published on flagged.html and the environment-matched demo value is the one modelled. The model fee is rounded up to 6 decimals - the official Fee Rounding page states 'trade fee = ceil_6dp(model fee)' - and the resulting balance change is then floored to the $0.01 alignment used for non-direct members, with the difference booked as the rounding fee (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding). Settlement is free: 'There is no settlement fee.' Resting-order (maker) fees are not modeled because every simulated fill crosses the spread.

momentum.enter: a sampled >= $0.10 move whose model score >= 0.45 and YES spread <= $0.06; buy the side the move points to (up -> YES, down -> NO)
momentum.exit: take-profit +$0.15, stop-loss -$0.10, else max 12 samples (~6 h) at the official bid, else settlement

fade.enter: a sampled >= $0.10 move whose model score < 0.45, spread <= $0.04 and 24 h volume >= 100 contracts; buy the opposite side
fade.exit: take-profit +$0.08, stop-loss -$0.08, else max 4 samples (~2 h) at the official bid, else settlement

breakout.enter: last price crosses the 50c line between two samples, with 24 h volume >= 500 contracts and spread <= $0.05; buy the side it crossed to
breakout.exit: take-profit +$0.12, stop-loss -$0.10, else max 48 samples (~24 h) at the official bid, else settlement

harvest.enter: last price between $0.90 and $0.99, spread <= $0.03, market closes within 72 h; buy YES to settlement (no take-profit, no stop)
harvest.exit: settlement only: $1.00 per winning contract, $0.00 per losing contract; no settlement fee
